# Vendored PDF.js runtime

This directory contains the legacy browser build from `pdfjs-dist` 5.6.205:

- `pdf.min.mjs`
- `pdf.worker.min.mjs`

It is loaded from the same static site as the Flight Plan Tool so DD1801 files
can be processed locally without a runtime CDN or third-party upload. PDF.js is
Copyright Mozilla Foundation and contributors and is licensed under Apache-2.0;
see `LICENSE` in this directory.

Upstream project: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
